topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: This city's got more secrets than a locked filing cabinet. Today, I'm looking at a kid, just out of high school, who says his college app essay is out there for the world to see, printed right up on the school's website. They’re calling it an “example.” Kid’s got no idea how the world works. Suspicion’s a shadow I carry, and this is no different. I’m digging for the truth, but the trail’s cold and paper-thin. The administrators, they play it cool, dodge and parry. Caught in the rain without an umbrella, that’s this kid. I’m mulling over the angles, the possible plays. Money, grades, maybe a rival. Ain’t nothing free in this town. Gonna need to dig deeper, see what shakes loose.
